hooks.name: Brief me on my task
hooks.description: At session start, show the task for the current branch and anything blocking it.

action.command: git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD | grep -oE '^[A-Z]+-[0-9]+' | sed 's/^/Current task id: /' || true

hooks.name: Sync task status when work is committed
hooks.description: When the agent stops, if a commit referencing a task id was made this session, update the row and leave an audit comment.

action.prompt: Check `git log --since='2 hours ago' --pretty='%h %s'` for commits referencing a task id (e.g. TASK-123). For each one, find the row in the sprint sheet via the smartsheet tools. If the work is finished and tests pass, set Status to Complete and set PR if a PR URL is known. Always add a discussion comment on that row describing what changed and which commit. If unsure whether the task is finished, set nothing and tell me instead.
